# `em select pkgconf show`

- **Usage:** `em select pkgconf show [-t --target <TARGET>]`

Show the backend the <target>-pkg-config wrapper currently points at

## Flags
- **`-t --target <TARGET>`** — Target tuple (CTARGET) to show the wrapper for
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

## Output Formats

- **`json`** — Machine-parsable JSON (`--json` with `-p` or `--info`)

  **Framing:** `json`
